# Program census

*Generated by `tools/census.py`: every program in /usr/bin, /usr/sbin, /sbin, /usr/ccs/bin, /usr/contrib/bin, /opt/Migration/bin, /opt/audio/bin, /opt/dce/bin, /opt/dcelocal/bin, /opt/hparray/bin, /opt/hpnp/bin, /opt/ifor/bin, /opt/ignite/bin, /opt/image/bin, /opt/nettladm/bin, /opt/pd/bin, /opt/screencapture/bin, /opt/sharedprint/bin, /opt/softbench/bin started once with no arguments
and no input, on the rust CPU, 20 s timeout.*

906 programs: 287 ok, 551 error, 7 signal, 34 timeout, 22 unimpl, 5 crash.
`error` is the program exiting with a usage message or similar, which is what most
commands do without arguments; `timeout` is usually a program waiting for a terminal.
`unimpl` names the system calls that stopped it, `crash` is an emulator-detected fault.
